facts.note: Forty-eight blocks east to west: the yard, the passage, the toll house and the rock round them.
Forty-eight blocks north to south: the court north of the yard, the cart road south of it, and rock on every side.
Thirty-two blocks from under the cart road to over the yard's roof.
The yard is sixteen blocks across, so the barred arch on its far side is read from the gate the party comes in by.
